text.p: Gothic Energy Corp and Pittencrieff Resources plc of the United Kingdom, said Monday they had terminated a previously announced letter of intent for Gothic to make a tender offer for Pittencrieff's outstanding capital stock.
In a statement, the parties said that no further negotiations were intended to be undertaken concerning the previously proposed transaction.
Gothic Energy officials were unavailable to explain any reason behind the termination of the proposed deal.

Gothic Energy is an oil and gas acquisition, exploitation, development and production company headquartered in Tulsa. The company announced on April 16 that it had signed a letter of intent to make an offer to acquire Pittencrieff for $0.979 a share or about $56 million.
Pittencrieff is an oil and gas exploration and production company with interests in about 1,600 producing oil and gas wells in the U.S. and Canada.
